name: leadforge
description: Open-source B2B lead generation engine: OSS Google Maps scraping, polite website deep-crawl for contacts and decision makers, ICP scoring, XLSX/CSV export. Heavy lifting in a Python CLI; the agent reads one-line digests and labels decision makers from snippets.

interface.shortDescription: B2B lead generation with OSS scrapers and ICP scoring
interface.longDescription: Interview the user about their ideal customer profile, then run a self-bootstrapping Python pipeline that scrapes Google Maps/Business listings, crawls business websites for contacts and decision makers, scores every lead against the ICP, and exports a styled XLSX + CSV backed by SQLite.
